item.title: Top 5 Methods to Convert Month Number to Month Name in SQL Server
item.description:
This guide covers five methods to convert month numbers (1-12) into month names (“January”, “February”, etc.) in SQL Server. Avoiding CASE statements, we leverage built-in SQL functions like DATENAME, FORMAT, and SUBSTRING. Each method includes unique code examples and explanations.

1. Using DATENAME with DATEADD for Month Name Conversion

The DATENAME function retrieves the name of a specified part of a date. Paired with DATEADD, this approach allows us to add the month number to a fixed date and retrieve the month name.
